# Robinhood Swap — Swap on Robinhood Chain Reference

> Trade ETH, USDC and tokens on Robinhood Chain — the EVM layer 2 — through a non-custodial decentralized exchange. Independent, not affiliated with Robinhood.

## Key Facts
- Robinhood Chain: EVM-compatible Ethereum layer 2 built with Arbitrum technology
- Gas: paid in ETH on Robinhood Chain
- Custody: non-custodial — swaps settle through public smart contracts; wallet signs
- Costs: DEX pool fee + network gas (ETH) + price impact; ERC-20 spend needs a one-time approval
- Common pairs: ETH <-> USDC / USDT and other tokens with on-chain liquidity
- Independent resource — NOT affiliated with or endorsed by Robinhood
